title: Feature request : Make it more explicit whether it’s Claude or Claude Code
body: Hi, when I select the Claude agent in the dropdown I’m not sure wether it’s actually Claude code or a custom Claude agent, like the one with GitHub Copilot. I would enjoy being sure which one it is.

linked_prs.title: Display claude-code executor as Claude Code rather than Claude

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue because it involves the selection and differentiation of LLM models (Claude vs. Claude Code), which relates to LLM provider integration and model configuration within the agent system.
